score_note: Physical-modelling flavour from comb filters; u-he's free synth with the most character.
description: A synthesizer that makes its sound with comb filters instead of oscillators: very short, chromatically tuned delays, often chained in series, give plucked, metallic and string-like tones, shaped by envelopes, LFOs and effects. VST3 only on Linux. Free, closed source.
name: Triple Cheese

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Its presets and skins go to ~/.u-he/TripleCheese, where it also keeps your own presets; Uninstall removes that folder too. u-he calls its Linux builds beta.
